title: Build the first helpdesk
user_prompt: Make me a little helpdesk website called RelayDesk. I want to upload this CSV of customer messages, see an inbox, open a message and write a reply draft. I don't need it to send emails. If a file cannot be read, tell me and keep the tickets already there. Please make it runnable on my laptop and include a way to check that it works.

title: Keep work and find tickets
user_prompt: Please keep the tickets and my drafts when I close and reopen it. Add a search box for the subject or customer's email, and let me mark a ticket closed and show it again later.

title: First AI provider
user_prompt: Can it suggest a reply using Pollen? I've attached their connection details. Put a button next to the draft. I want to review the suggestion before using it, and keep anything I already typed unless I choose to replace it.

title: A second choice
user_prompt: Add Comet as another option, using these instructions. Let me choose either one when asking for a suggestion, and remember my usual choice. Everything else should work the same.

title: Two separate teams
user_prompt: Two support teams will use this. Give each team its own tickets, drafts, saved provider choice and connection details. A person from one team mustn't be able to see the other team's stuff, even by copying a ticket link.

title: Show replies arriving
user_prompt: Pollen can now show the reply as it arrives. Please do that so people aren't staring at a blank box. If I pick Comet, just show a working message until its reply is ready. Don't lose my original draft if something fails.

title: Answers from our help articles
user_prompt: Let people search our help articles and include the ones they select when asking for a reply. Show links to those articles beside the suggestion so the person can check them, and keep the links when they accept it. Use this article service.

title: Look up an order
user_prompt: Most messages are about orders. Let the person enter an order number, fetch its status and total from this service, and choose to include that in the reply request. Show the total in dollars. Never fetch an order unless they ask.

title: Handle outages
user_prompt: Sometimes these AI services are busy. Please retry temporary failures twice, respect their ‘try again in this many seconds’ message, and tell me clearly when it still hasn't worked. A bad connection key shouldn't keep retrying. Stick with the service I chose and keep my work safe.

title: A slow third provider
user_prompt: We want Harbor too. It gives you a job number and you have to come back for the answer; their notes are attached. Show that it's working while we wait. It doesn't do the word-by-word display, and that's fine.

title: Work through a batch
user_prompt: Let me select up to ten tickets and ask for suggestions in the background. I should be able to leave the page and come back. If the app restarts halfway through, the finished suggestions should still be there and unfinished tickets should carry on.

title: Stop unwanted work
user_prompt: Add a stop button for an unfinished suggestion, including ones in a batch. Once I stop it, a late answer mustn't appear in my draft. For Harbor, tell their service to cancel too. Stopping one ticket mustn't stop the others.

title: Fourth provider with different output
user_prompt: Please add Quartz using the attached notes. It sends the words and article references separately. Show both properly. It can't look up orders itself, so include only the order information the person has already fetched and chosen to use.

title: Retire Comet
user_prompt: We're dropping Comet. Remove it from new work, but keep old suggestions readable with the name of the service that made them. If someone had Comet selected, ask them to choose another option. Don't silently send their message somewhere else.

title: A small visual release
user_prompt: Give the inbox a font menu with these two supplied fonts. Remember my choice in this browser. Nothing about tickets or replies should change. I'd like to put this visual update live while the reply jobs already running carry on.

title: A change that really crosses boundaries
user_prompt: Our shops now sell in dollars, euros and yen. The order service has changed as described here. Show the right currency and amount wherever an order appears, including the information sent for a reply. Old saved orders were all dollars and must still display correctly. Keep jobs already waiting in the queue working during the update.
